# EU Funding Calls · Ullswater Investments

> Every open and forthcoming EU funding call (Horizon Europe, Digital Europe, EDF, LIFE, EU4Health, cascade funding and more), refreshed daily from the European Commission's Funding & Tenders Portal. Run by Ullswater Investments S.L., EU funding advisors in Madrid (https://www.ullswaterinvestments.com/).

## Data
- [All calls as JSON](https://calls.ullswaterinvestments.com/data/calls.json): id, title, programme, status, opening, deadline, budget, URL
- [Summary statistics](https://calls.ullswaterinvestments.com/data/stats.json)
- [Spanish national and regional calls (BDNS) as JSON](https://calls.ullswaterinvestments.com/data/spain.json)
